property_summary: For any inputs to initialize within admissible bounds, the reference contract preserves the provided _feeRate in its public feeRate getter (feeRate() == _feeRate); the mutant forces feeRate to 0 so this equality can be violated for some fuzzed _feeRate != 0.
change_summary: Replace the assignment to feeRate with assignment of a different value (force feeRate to 0) to change observed feeRate after initialize.
